episodes.title: How To Make Small Talk
episodes.summary: John Wilson reflects on the delicate balancing act of making - and safely redirecting - casual conversation, highlighting the rewards and risks of small talk.

episodes.title: How To Put Up Scaffolding
episodes.summary: John Wilson offers a unique history of New York's hideous yet sprawling network of overhead "protection," otherwise known as scaffolding - and contemplates what it might take to reduce its nearly 300-mile eyesore presently overtaking the city.

episodes.title: How To Improve Your Memory
episodes.summary: John Wilson taps into his "Memory Palace" for an unforgettable exploration into our ability - or inability - to remember things.

episodes.title: How To Cover Your Furniture
episodes.summary: While trying to live peacefully with his furniture destroying cat, John Wilson explores the challenges of keeping an object in pristine condition

episodes.title: How To Split the Check
episodes.summary: John Wilson attempts to make sense of the intricacies - and fairness practices - behind the complex art of splitting the check.

episodes.title: How To Cook the Perfect Risotto
episodes.summary: To thank his elderly landlord for all the times she has cooked and cleaned for him, John attempts to make her favorite dish.

episodes.title: How To Invest in Real Estate
episodes.summary: After renting the same apartment for years, John contemplates an unexpected opportunity to become a homeowner.

episodes.title: How To Appreciate Wine
episodes.summary: When confronted by the overwhelming and mysterious world of wine, John attempts to master his senses and make informed choices.

episodes.title: How To Find a Spot
episodes.summary: John reflects on the competitive and complex process of parking in NYC, where the possibilities opened by having a car comes with a catch.

episodes.title: How To Throw Out Your Batteries
episodes.summary: Seeking a solution to the universal conundrum of battery disposal, John ponders the value of things we hold onto – and what we throw away.

episodes.title: How To Remember Your Dreams
episodes.summary: After years of rooting his life in non-fiction, John drifts from the world of rational thought in hopes of finally remembering his dreams.

episodes.title: How To Be Spontaneous
episodes.summary: Though determined to let fate be his guide, John's attempt at spontaneity doesn't go as planned.

episodes.title: How to Find a Public Restroom
episodes.summary: As the availability of public restrooms dwindles in NYC, John tries to find clever ways to relieve himself.

episodes.title: How to Clean Your Ears
episodes.summary: After having his ears properly cleaned, John wonders if better hearing is what he actually wants.

episodes.title: How To Work Out
episodes.summary: John starts working out and tracks the pros and cons of big.

episodes.title: How to Watch the Game
episodes.summary: John's discovery of the deeply-embedded rituals and bonding in sports leads to a greater appreciation of the game.

episodes.title: How To Watch Birds
episodes.summary: John thinks he is spending too much time indoors and decides to try out the activity of birding.

episodes.title: How to Track Your Package
episodes.summary: After having a delivery stolen, John investigates how to keep his packages secure.
